answer: Put cough acoustic signature proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 4927 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A shale of doubt is healthy, a tide of proof is required, and a beacon of patience is the price of a clean panel. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
